description: Baugher records 67-21376 on display at New York ANG Newburgh; a US National Archives/DVIDS image dated 5 Oct 2001 captions it as the 105th Airlift Wing's newly installed static display aircraft with Stewart Building 202 behind; still charged to 105 AW/MXS on the April 2016 NMUSAF loan list; no 2023-26 sighting found
